publication_scope.study_type: retrospective development benchmark and integration audit

primary_method.name: PanelHLA-Consensus
primary_method.selection_status: previously selected on development evidence and disclosed as post hoc
primary_method.singleton_definition: A caller output with only one resolved allele is not a callable diploid genotype and casts no vote. Homozygosity is accepted only when two matching alleles or an explicit caller-native homozygous declaration are present.
primary_method.commitment: The corrected result is retained regardless of direction; the primary method will not be reselected after regeneration.

inference.primary: descriptive fixed-denominator accuracy with uncertainty and subject-clustered paired tests

reproducibility_boundary.ends_at: manuscript, supplement, figures, DOCX, and release manifest
reproducibility_boundary.upstream_raw_read_workflow: external dependency outside the verified paper repository
reproducibility_boundary.development_truth: reconstructed from the checksum-pinned public 2014 1000 Genomes HLA resource
